sourceMaterials.title: Condition Summary
sourceMaterials.verification: third-party 3.0 SRD transcription, not independently verified against source release

sourceMaterials.title: Native six-level Exhaustion
sourceMaterials.verification: previously adopted Dorks & Dice SRD 5.1 rule

edition3x: after one hour complete rest changes to Fatigued

native-Exhaustion.edition5x: six cumulative tiers for checks, Speed, attacks, saving throws, HP maximum, and death

decisions.decision: Independent condition: Run/Charge prohibited, effective Str/Dex -2 and associated derived statistics, 8-hour complete rest ends it unless source specifies otherwise.
Maintain six-tier SRD 5.1 rule and existing recovery. Do not map the 3.x Exhausted mechanics to a specific tier without explicit native reconciliation.
The 3.x second Fatigue consequence/Exhausted condition is not numerically or narratively equivalent to a single native Exhaustion level; conversion needs an explicit rule.
The older rule escalates additional Fatigue to Exhausted. Do not change the shared condition-stacking semantics or remove native Exhaustion levels automatically.

nonGoals: Introduce a second parallel Exhaustion condition with an equivalent name
Automatically equate 3.x +5.x ability penalties to Disadvantage
Implement rest scheduling or core gameplay runtime
rights: Only independently paraphrased native condition mechanics are stored. Historical SRD excerpts, if imported, must preserve OGL scope independently from SRD 5.x CC BY.
